The Gateway

San Francisco Campus

As part of our San Francisco Campus, Bay Club at The Gateway is your very own active lifestyle resort, just steps away from the iconic Ferry Building. With views of the skyline and Bay Bridge, you’ll enjoy a workout on one of our six fully lit tennis courts or in the only outdoor aquatic center in downtown San Francisco (with not one, but two heated pools). Whatever you need to live life happy—it’s all at the Bay Club.
